name: Calm Eel 15
author: themrsami
description: Gradient pill black text input that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #333 to #555, box-shadow becomes 0 0 15px #ffffff, transform becomes translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 30px #ffffff, transform becomes translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.2), background changes from radial-gradient(circle, #ffffff, transparent) to radial-gradient(circle, #ffffff, transparent).
